info.title: Sadat Real Estate API
info.description: Executable contract for implemented routes only. Product routes use /api/v1; operational probes remain at the process root.

servers.description: Local synthetic default; replace with an explicitly approved non-production or production origin.

post.summary: Authenticate an Admin with normalized email and password
Create and deliver a bounded phone OTP challenge
Verify a phone OTP for login or a one-time registration authority
Create a seeker account from a verified phone registration authority

patch.summary: Update allowlisted fields on the authenticated seeker's own search preferences

post.summary: Create a provider onboarding draft from a verified provider OTP authority

get.summary: Read the authenticated provider's own application

patch.summary: Save allowlisted common fields on an owned editable provider draft
Save brokerage-office fields on an owned editable provider draft
Save developer-company fields on an owned editable provider draft

get.summary: Read the authenticated provider's application status and available actions

post.summary: Stream an owned provider document into private quarantine
post.description: The filename is display metadata only. The server generates the object key, validates extension/MIME/signature and size, fingerprints the bytes, and fails access closed until malware scanning reports clean.

post.summary: Authorize a 300-second exact-object private download grant

delete.summary: Delete an owned private document and revoke its delivery path

get.summary: List dynamic administrative roles and the approved capability catalog
get.description: Requires admin:roles.view. The response exposes the caller's effective permissions and derives availableActions server-side.

post.description: Requires admin:roles.manage and a reason. View Only roles accept only .view capabilities; persisted roles never accept wildcards. The mutation and its redacted audit record commit atomically.

patch.summary: Update a dynamic administrative role with optimistic concurrency
patch.description: Requires admin:roles.manage and a reason. Deactivation revokes grants from that role; the request version prevents lost updates. The mutation and its redacted audit record commit atomically.

get.description: Requires admin:audit.view. Filters are allowlisted, snapshots are redacted and bounded, and signed URLs, credentials, tokens, and sensitive personal identifiers are never exposed.

get.summary: Get one append-only sensitive-action audit record
get.description: Requires admin:audit.view. Authorization is evaluated for every request and the response remains no-store.
Requires admin:locations.view. Filters and sorting are allowlisted and pagination is bounded.

post.description: Requires admin:locations.manage. Uses strict localized names, a unique stable slug, deterministic ordering, optional coordinates, and reason-bearing audit.

patch.summary: Update, reorder, move, or activate a location resource
patch.description: Requires admin:locations.manage, the current optimistic version, and a reason. Neighborhood parents must exist.

delete.description: Requires admin:locations.manage, the current optimistic version, and a reason. Child-neighborhood and Provider references fail closed.

post.summary: Create a property category or type
Apply a reason-bearing account state transition
post.description: Requires admin:users.manage. Provider approval, rejection, needs-information, and suspension use the dedicated provider-review route. Admin targets and self-transitions fail closed. Every successful transition revokes active refresh sessions and appends traceable transition evidence.

post.summary: Review a Provider application and its account state atomically
post.description: Requires admin:providers.review. The providerId is the current Provider application ID. Verification means platform administrative approval only and never government, ownership, registry, OCR, legal, bank, or other automatic verification.

get.summary: Redeem a short-lived exact-object private download grant

parameters.name: signature
parameters.description: Ephemeral bearer signature returned only after fresh authorization; never persist or log it.

200.description: Private attachment; Cache-Control is private, no-store

refreshCookie.name: sadat_refresh
refreshCookie.description: Opaque rotating refresh token. Never exposed in a response body.

bearerAuth.description: Short-lived access token issued by the shared authentication session boundary.

AuthSessionSuccess.description: Authenticated session established; refresh token is set as an HttpOnly cookie

Set-Cookie.description: Rotating sadat_refresh cookie with HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, scoped Path, and Secure outside Local/Test

OtpSendSuccess.description: OTP challenge accepted for delivery; the code is never returned

OtpVerifySuccess.description: Existing account authenticated or a single-use registration authority issued

Set-Cookie.description: Present only for an authenticated outcome; sets the rotating sadat_refresh cookie

LogoutSuccess.description: Current refresh session revoked and cookie cleared

AuthError.description: Authentication, account-state, replay, or rate-limit failure

SeekerRegistrationSuccess.description: Seeker account created from a verified OTP authority; refresh token is set as an HttpOnly cookie

SeekerProfileSuccess.description: The authenticated seeker's own public profile projection

SeekerPreferencesSuccess.description: The authenticated seeker's own search preferences

SeekerError.description: Seeker authentication, ownership, registration, or validation failure

ProviderRegistrationSuccess.description: Provider draft created from verified OTP authority; refresh token is set as an HttpOnly cookie

ProviderApplicationSuccess.description: The authenticated provider's owned application projection

ProviderStatusSuccess.description: The authenticated provider's owned application status

ProviderError.description: Provider registration, authentication, ownership, completeness, state, or version failure

ProviderDocumentSuccess.description: Safe private-document metadata; no storage key or permanent URL

ProviderDocumentAccessSuccess.description: Freshly authorized 300-second GET-only private delivery grant

ProviderDocumentDeleteSuccess.description: Private document binary deleted and future delivery revoked

ProviderDocumentError.description: Upload validation, authorization, ownership, scan, state, or readiness failure

RbacRoleListSuccess.description: Dynamic role list and effective capability projection

RbacError.description: RBAC authentication, authorization, validation, lookup, or concurrency failure

AuditLogListSuccess.description: Paginated append-only audit records using explicit redacted projections

AuditLogSuccess.description: One append-only audit record using an explicit redacted projection

AuditError.description: Audit authentication, authorization, validation, lookup, or persistence failure

LocationError.description: Location authentication, authorization, validation, hierarchy, lookup, reference, slug, or concurrency failure

ProviderReviewSuccess.description: Atomic Provider application and account review projection

AccountError.description: Account authentication, authorization, lookup, state, or concurrency failure

X-Request-Id.description: Validated request correlation identifier; generated when the inbound value is absent or malformed.

Traceparent.description: W3C trace context for this API span.

NormalizedPhone.description: Canonical E.164 phone number after removing allowed presentation separators or converting a 00 prefix

RegistrationToken.description: Single-use opaque authority returned by verified registration OTP.

url.description: Ephemeral bearer URL; never persist, log, audit, analyze, or list.

AuditSnapshot.description: Bounded JSON snapshot redacted before persistence and again before delivery. Secret, token, credential, signed-URL, email, and phone values are not exposed.

otp.description: Present when the authentication runtime is installed

privateDocuments.description: Present when the private-document runtime is installed; fails closed when storage or scanning is unavailable
